reading.grounds: The player says the character has always lived here and is originally present at the salt pans: an explicit native, already-there presence with no arrival, portal, transfer or summoning.
reading.evidence_quote: I am originally present at the salt pans

assessments.grounds: A quiet salt-marsh hamlet is consistent with a human salt-raker living there; it neither adds to nor excludes the presence.
The canon only says the place is invented; it excludes no kind of inhabitant.
The direction of the wind has no bearing on a human character living at the salt pans.
The statement names the same place as the locus.
